title: Regional retention tiers + SCC alignment: pricing & contract experiment
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design and run a pricing and contract packaging experiment to evaluate how explicit regional retention tiers and SCC (EU/UK) alignment affect enterprise conversion and revenue. Deliverables: 1) concrete contract language options (DPA + SCC addendum variants) for four retention tiers, 2) pricing matrix and packaging UI copy for Console, 3) a security-questionnaire response bundle and subprocessors disclosure workflow, 4) experiment plan and dashboards to measure conversion/ARR impact.
acceptance_criteria: Legal-approved DPA snippets for 'session-only', '30d', '90d', and 'custom-1yr' retention with clear SCC clause options
Pricing table drafted and implemented in Console mock with delta pricing for EU-hosted vs global-hosted options
Security questionnaire response pack (standard answers + appendix for SCC choices) produced and stored in Drive
Experiment A/B plan instrumented: track trials -> contract sign -> ARR uplift and time-to-close
Subprocessor disclosure mechanism implemented as a linkable artifact for sales and embedded in DPA
notes_and_discussion: 2026-01-15: Kickoff with Legal (Ava Kim) and SalesOps (Diego Martinez). Alignment: we need conservative SCC language that is modular so we can toggle EU-only hosting as a purchasable feature.

2026-01-18: Product UX (Maya Patel) shared initial Console copy for retention picker; concerns raised about cognitive load for self-serve users. Recommendation: hide advanced retention options behind 'Enterprise settings' and surface a short summary.

2026-01-20: Engineering (ENG-2846) flagged implementation constraint: existing DPA plumbing expects a single 'data_location' flag. Will add a small backend toggle and new DPA template resolver (estimate 3 points).

2026-01-22: Sales feedback: mid-market customers expect 'subprocessors list' link directly inside the quote; enterprise customers want monthly updated CSV and attestation. We'll prototype both approaches.
2026-01-25: Security requested an HSM/KMS snippet for Private deployments and guidance for customers who require dedicated key management (added to questionnaire pack).

2026-01-27: Risk discussion: offering retention tiers with lower retention (session-only) could reduce observable telemetry available for debugging. Ops requires opt-in for extended debug logging separate from user retention choice.
decisions: Use four pricing/contract tiers: 'Session-only (no retention)', '30-day', '90-day (default)', 'Custom 1-year (enterprise only)'.

Provide two SCC alignment options: 'Standard SCC addendum' for global-hosted customers and 'EU/UK SCC+EU Hosting' bundle for customers requiring EU-only processing with SCCs and local subprocessors disclosure.
Expose retention tier and SCC choice in sales quote generator; self-serve will surface only '90-day' and a one-click 'EU hosting' add-on to reduce complexity.
Subprocessor disclosure will be published via a living Drive CSV and reachable link in the DPA; sales can attach snapshot CSVs to quotes for enterprise audits.

Engineering (Evan Liu): Implement DPA template resolver and retention toggle in backend (estimate 3 points) - IN PROGRESS
UX (Maya Patel): Update Console mock to hide advanced retention behind Enterprise settings; create microcopy explaining operational tradeoffs (due 2026-01-26)
SalesOps (Diego Martinez): Create quote generator hook to attach current subprocessors CSV and SCC selection options (due 2026-02-02)

metrics_and_targets: Target conversion uplift: +6% enterprise sign rate when EU-hosting + SCCs are offered vs baseline
Target ARPA uplift: +12% for customers choosing 'Custom 1-year' retention
Target time-to-close reduction: -8% for customers accepting standardized DPA + SCC addendum vs bespoke negotiation
Experiment measurement window: 60 days from rollout
